title: Speeder Bike dash
description: Return of the Jedi was directed the late Richard Marquand (Jagged Edge, Eye of the Needle), who passed away in 1987 of a heart ailment at a tragically young age. The film's screenplay, which follows its heroic characters from Jabba the Hutt's palace on Tatooine to the forest-laden moon of Endor, was once again written by Lawrence Kasdan and Lucas, based on Lucas' original story. Howard G. Kazanjian served as producer.
